[David Altig](http://macroblog.typepad.com/macroblog/2006/05/why_betting_aga.html "David Altig"), on why the USD is the currency you run to, not from:

*to anyone waiting for the greenback slaughter, I have one question: If, heaven forbid, the global economy goes south, who ya gonna call?*
